# Chain length and privileged-action density in the AI Village dataset

*Generated by `analysis/ai_village_chains.py`. Source: `aidigestorg/ai-village` (AI Digest), research terms; aggregate statistics only. Privileged classes are assigned by regex over bash commands and tool arguments, mirroring Charter §5: P1 out-of-workspace file-tool paths (Claude Code stream only), P2 network, P3 credentials, P4 agent/process-launch patterns. The classifier is syntactic; its development calibration is not held-out validation. GUI network actions are unobserved, and regex false positives and false negatives both remain possible.*

## Reading

The pⁿ and pᵏ columns are hypothetical sensitivity calculations assuming the same independent survival probability p at every selected step. They are not measured throughput, completion or causal effects. The Village had no randomized declaration-gate intervention. A zero proxy count does not establish that a session contained no privileged behavior. Regex calibration used development examples with LLM-judge agreement and unequal sampling strata, not an independent population validation. P4 includes detached processes, not only agents.
